summary: message batch send optimization (124 msgs in 1 session, 99% gap <5s = batch pattern, needs merging)
preconditions: tool 'message' session contains >10 consecutive msgs with gap <5s
validation: python3 -c 'import json; evts=[json.loads(l) for l in open("openclaw-harness/events/events.jsonl")]; batch=sum(1 for e in evts if e.get("tool_name")=="message"); print(f"message_batch_total={batch}")'
strategy: 同一 session gap <5s 内连续 message 合并为 1 次批量发送
batch size >10 必须拆分中间确认 (避免消息过长)
message content >4000 chars 超则自动拆分 (飞书 4000 char 上限)
飞书 API rate limit 20 msg/s 上限，burst >20 排队
cross_library_evidence: BeautifulMathematics 幂等性 (batch 发送幂等)
cell-biology 反馈回路 (发送速率控制)
CognitivePsychology attention bottleneck (batch 太长注意力流失)
OpenStaxBiology 膜流动性 (message 边界隔离)
